block_selection_rationale: The newest COMPLETE six-month block is bounded by the NOAA ISD Global Hourly (observations) archive, which supplies the realized-Tmax label and lags well behind the numerical forecast archives. Direct probe (2026-09-29) confirmed the 2026 annual observations file does not exist (HTTP 404) and the 2025 annual file's real content ends at ~2025-08-25..08-27 (per-station). 2025H1 (Jan-Jun 2025) is therefore the true newest complete block, with a ~2-month safety margin before that cutoff. See scripts/backfill_common.py module docstring for the full investigation.
